//go:build sessionless_search_offline

package providerloopsession

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/x509"
	"net"
	"net/netip"
)

// Present only in the additive test binary, before the original session starts.
// No Source/Store/keeper/issuer is replaced and no invocation gate is reset.
func (v *LocalV1) ConfigureSearchOfflineNetwork(lookup func(context.Context, string) ([]netip.Addr, error), dial func(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error), roots *x509.CertPool) error {
	if v == nil || v.state == nil {
		return ErrSession
	}
	s := v.state
	select {
	case s.gate <- struct{}{}:
	default:
		return ErrBusy
	}
	defer func() { <-s.gate }()
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.credentialed || s.closed || s.started || s.attempted || s.runtimeStarted || s.entry != nil || s.keeper == nil || s.searchCredentials == nil || s.ctx == nil || s.ctx.Err() != nil {
		return ErrSession
	}
	return s.keeper.ConfigureSearchOfflineNetwork(lookup, dial, roots)
}

// Do not reenter the engine gate while its synchronous borrow is active, or
// hold the state mutex through socket cleanup. This can only stop its keeper.
func (v *LocalV1) StopActiveSearchOffline() error {
	if v == nil || v.state == nil {
		return ErrSession
	}
	s := v.state
	s.mu.Lock()
	keeper := s.keeper
	valid := !s.closed && s.runtimeStarted && s.entry != nil && keeper != nil && s.ctx != nil && s.ctx.Err() == nil
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if !valid {
		return ErrSession
	}
	return keeper.StopActiveSearchOffline()
}
